say:3:1421111001:1.text: What can I do for the three of you?
say:3:1421111001:1.source_cn: 漂亮的小姐，这位卫队的大人，还有这位……呃，你们有什么事啊？

say:4:1421111002:1.text: Madam, sorry for bothering you. We're minstrels, and we're working on a poem to honor Captain Indris!
say:4:1421111002:1.source_cn: 夫人！打扰您啦，我们是想要为因度厄大人创作一首诗歌的吟...

say:5:1421111003:1.text: It's too early to call ourselves that...
say:5:1421111003:1.source_cn: ……现在还不是吟游诗人呢，你也说得太早了。

say:6:1421111004:1.text: Hey, it's just a matter of time, right? And don't say that in front of other people!
say:6:1421111004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，早晚会是的！你不要给我拆台嘛！

say:7:1421111005:1.text: Madam, is it true that Captain Indris lived here when he was young? Did anything interesting happen during that time?
say:7:1421111005:1.source_cn: 所以，夫人，我想问问，因度厄大人他年轻的时候是住在这边...

say:8:1421111006:1.text: Indris... He was a diligent and stubborn child when he was young. I can't believe he has become the great man he is today...
say:8:1421111006:1.source_cn: 因度厄那小子啊，他小时候就是个认真又倔强的孩子，现在也...

say:9:1421111007:0.text: Hmm, I remember he was already bright and strong back then.
say:9:1421111007:0.source_cn: 唔，我记得他小时候很聪明，而且身手也不错。

say:10:1421111008:1.text: Go further down that road, and you'll meet a guy named <style="highlight">Venlo</style>.
say:10:1421111008:1.source_cn: 你们再往前头走走，有个叫<style=highligh...

say:11:1421111009:1.text: He's about the same age as Indris. Their families were close when they were young. No one knows more about Indris' childhood than him!
say:11:1421111009:1.source_cn: 他们两家比较亲密，他俩年纪也差不多，要说知道因度厄小时...

say:12:1421111010:1.text: Alright, we'll go look for him then. Thanks for the information!
say:12:1421111010:1.source_cn: 好的，我们这就去问问，谢谢您啦，夫人！

say:13:1421111011:1.text: Oh, wait a second! I just remembered that Venlo's been gone days trying to look for food...
say:13:1421111011:1.source_cn: 啊，等一下！我想起来了，前天有人说到，芬洛好像去找食物...

say:14:1421111012:1.text: Could he be in danger? But then again, what could have gone wrong on a trip like that...?
say:14:1421111012:1.source_cn: 出门不归，是遇到危险了吗？但是找食物也会有危险吗……

say:15:1421111013:1.text: When the commoners look for food, they don't go to the shopping streets.
say:15:1421111013:1.source_cn: 我的大小姐，真正穷苦的平民们的“找食物”和上街购物可是...

say:16:1421111014:1.text: Places with food... Hmm, I think I know where he might be.
say:16:1421111014:1.source_cn: 能找食物的地方……嗯，我大概有数了，往这边来。

say:17:1421111015:1.source_cn: 跟我走吧，记得保护好自己。
